platform.description: The platform this extension is for (e.g., iOS, Android, Web Components, Qt)

platformVersion.description: Optional platform version or framework version

description.description: Description of what this extension provides

extends.description: Which registry this extends (sizes, states, variants, etc.)

componentOptions.description: Per-component option/value aliasing for this platform. Unlike `extensions` (which aliases a shared registry term everywhere it's used), these entries scope to one component's own `options` map — the right home for a naming difference that isn't backed by a shared registry (e.g. Button's `style` option vs. React's `fillStyle` prop).

component.description: Component `name` (as declared in its component.schema.json file, e.g. 'button') this extension applies to.

option.description: Canonical option name from the component's `options` map (e.g. 'style').

platformProp.description: This platform's name for the option (e.g. 'fillStyle').

platformAttribute.description: This platform's HTML/DOM attribute name, when it differs from platformProp (e.g. Web Components' fill-style attribute vs. its fillStyle JS property). Omit if not applicable or identical to platformProp.

platformAliases.description: Other names this platform has used for the same concept (e.g. during a migration).

notes.description: Free-text context for why the names differ.

values.description: Per-value aliasing, for options whose values differ in casing or spelling across platforms (e.g. size 's'|'m'|'l'|'xl' canonical vs. React's 'S'|'M'|'L'|'XL').

value.description: Canonical value, from the component's options[option].values.

platformValue.description: This platform's value for the same concept.

platformOnlyValues.description: Values this platform's implementation accepts that have NO canonical/Figma counterpart (e.g. React Button's 'premium'/'genai' variants). Recorded here — not silently mapped to the nearest lookalike — so design-system drift between platforms is visible rather than papered over. A generator producing Code Connect templates from this data MUST NOT emit a figma.enum() entry for these; they can never appear in a Figma-driven example because no Figma variant represents them.

termId.description: The ID of the term being extended (must exist in the base registry)

reference.description: Platform documentation reference or API name

differences.description: Key differences from the base term
